contents.name: Lowest-order trimmed polynomial spaces identify Nedelec first-family and RT0 shape spaces
contents.detail: §5.2, printed pp. 50–53, identifies the trimmed degree-one spaces and their face/edge degrees of freedom; local carriers define and check the concrete 3D Whitney basis.

contents.name: Canonical degrees of freedom on lower-dimensional simplices need stronger regularity
contents.detail: §5.4, printed pp. 54–55, explains that canonical interpolation uses traces on lower-dimensional simplices and is not bounded on L2 or HΛ; the local item gives an explicit H(curl)-norm counterexample.

contents.name: Bounded cochain projection induces discrete stability and Poincare estimates
contents.detail: §3.3, printed pp. 22–24, gives the abstract projection framework and a complete discrete Poincare argument; §5.5, printed pp. 56–57, outlines smoothing, inversion on the finite-element subspace, and commutation.

contents.name: Smoothed projection boundary correction and complete uniform operator estimates
contents.reason: §5.5 explicitly provides only a brief outline and refers to other work; no missing extension or boundary-correction proof is imported as a completed local argument.

contents.name: Whitney finite element complex has simplicial cohomology and topology-dependent harmonic forms
contents.detail: §3.1 and §5.6, printed pp. 17–18 and 57–58; the local proof derives the actual cochain isomorphism from the degrees of freedom and uses the repository's proved simplicial/singular comparison.

contents.name: Hilbert de Rham graph spaces and differential complexes
contents.detail: §§3–4, printed pp. 16–44, define the Hilbert-complex setting; the local definition fixes the vector-valued distributional convention explicitly.

contents.name: Hodge Laplacian mixed formulation and harmonic gauge
contents.detail: §3.4, printed pp. 25–28, treats the harmonic-space multiplier; the local theorem proves a finite-dimensional quotient-energy version.

contents.name: Projection-derived uniform discrete Poincare inequality
contents.detail: Theorem 3.6, printed p. 24, has a complete short proof from a bounded cochain projection; its separate discrete-compactness remark in §3.6 is not a full proof of the present statement.

contents.name: Weak L2 curl-free fields have a global H1 potential on contractible Lipschitz domains
contents.reason: The source discusses smooth/de Rham and finite-element cohomology; it does not prove the required weak L2 local-to-global potential with global H1 integrability.

contents.name: Local mesh-size function and variable-scale pullback smoothing on graded meshes
contents.detail: §5.5, printed pp. 56–57, introduces a Lipschitz local mesh scale and variable-scale averaged pullbacks for shape-regular graded meshes; the local proof establishes the vertex-patch and strict inward/outward boundary estimates.

contents.name: Averaged pullback moments and commuting cochain construction
contents.detail: §5.5, printed pp. 56–57, outlines smoothed canonical moments and commutation; the local proof supplies representative independence, graded-mesh L2 bounds, relative zero-boundary conformity and the prism estimate.

contents.name: Finite-element inverse correction and convergence of smoothed projections
contents.detail: §5.5, printed pp. 56–57, outlines inversion of the smoothed operator on the finite-element subspace; the local proof gives the Neumann-series inverse, idempotence, graph bounds and strong/compact-uniform convergence.

contents.name: Projection-based discrete gradient gap estimate
contents.detail: §3.3, Theorem 3.6, printed pp. 24–25, proves the abstract projection-based discrete Poincare route; the local lemma derives the stronger exact orthogonal-gradient lift bound used by the compactness proof.

contents.name: Full-Dirichlet regular decomposition
